intro: You are travelling to the market. Buy a bus ticket from the conductor.

conversation.speaker: conductor
conversation.text: Tickets, please. Where are you going?

conversation.speaker: student
expected: I am going to the market.
I want to go to the market.
conversation.hint: Try: "I am going to the market."

conversation.speaker: conductor
conversation.text: One ticket to the market. That is fifteen rupees.

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Give him the money and ask for change.
expected: Here you are. Can I have the change?
Here is the money, please give me change.

conversation.speaker: conductor
conversation.text: Here is your change and your ticket. Keep it safely.

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Ask how many stops until the market.
expected: How many stops until the market?

conversation.speaker: conductor
conversation.text: Four stops. I will tell you when we arrive.

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Ask him to tell you when to get down.
expected: Please tell me when to get down.
Could you tell me when to get down?
Please let me know when we arrive.
conversation.hint: Try: "Please tell me when to get down."

conversation.speaker: conductor
conversation.text: This is your stop. Mind the step as you get down.

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Thank the conductor and get down.
